text_block_list.text:
A public training session is held for the
media in
preparation for the spring
Tenno Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Chatter, chatter...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Phew...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
And that concludes today's public
training!
text_block_list.name: Staff Member

text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ, excuse me! Could I get a

one-on-one interview with you, please?
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text:
I understand Нарита Таисин will also be
at the
spring Tenno Sho. As a fellow
member of BNW—
text_block_list.name: Репортёр B
choice_data_list: Everyone, please give her some room!

text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ's consistent performance
has been
earning her a lot of attention.
While we're
certainly grateful for it...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Excuse me, Бива Хаяхидэ! Over here!
text_block_list.name: Press

text_block_list.text:
She can't possibly accommodate every
single
interview request. We politely
make our way
through the throng of
reporters and head home.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you didn't have to be so
protective. They
weren't bothering me.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: I need you to stay focused.

text_block_list.text: Hmm.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Well, thank you for making sure they
didn't
distract me. By the way, do you
happen to be free
this weekend?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
There's something important happening
then, and
it pertains to us both.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
The weekend rolls around, and it doesn't
take
long to figure out why Biwa
Hayahide wants to
spend it with me.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
What an absolutely gorgeous day at the

Nakayama Racecourse!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
And here she is, the number one favorite
of the
Satsuki Sho, Нарита Брайан!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text:
Listen to those cheers... I guess this is all
part of
the Нарита Брайан package.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Ka-chak!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан is in excellent position, but

everyone's hot on her heels coming out
of the
first corner.
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
In stark contrast to the lively audience,
Biwa
Hayahide watches the race unfold
in
contemplative silence.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
They're moving at a pretty fast clip.
There's only
800 meters to go! This level
of intensity is bound
to shake some of
them.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The pace is fast, but the lead is just
barely ahead
of the pack.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
This might come down to whoever has
enough
energy left on the straightaway.
I have a feeling
it'll be close...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Huff!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан! Нарита Брайан's broken away
from the
pack!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
She's in the lead! She's pulled away by
three
lengths—now four! She's widening
the gap!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
And it's a total blowout! We have a new
record!
Нарита Брайан has captured her
first crown in
devastating fashion!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
This is incredible, folks! Нарита Брайан has
not only
won the race, she's set a new
record!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан is now the fastest
Umamusume ever
to run the
2,000-meter at the Nakayama

Racecourse.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
That final sprint down the stretch was on
a whole
other level. She may be a
one-in-a-million
Umamusume...
text_block_list.name: Commentator

text_block_list.text: Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: I'm going to beat her.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I can only speculate as to what she might
have
said if she had watched this race
prior to running
in the Kikuka Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But what I do know for sure is that she's
starting
to sound a lot more like a real
fighter lately.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Bzzz, bzzz, bzzz.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hm? I think you're getting a call.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I take a look at my phone and raise my
eyebrows
at the name on the screen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I see. So this year's spring Tenno Sho will
be held
at the Hanshin Racecourse.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Apparently, the Kyoto Racecourse is
being
remodeled, so the venue for the
spring Tenno Sho
is being relocated to
the Hanshin Racecourse.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: But the problem is...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hm, both of them are right-handed
courses, but
the slopes are positioned
differently. The area
before the finish
line at Kyoto is flat, but Hanshin
has a
steep incline.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
There's no use complaining about it, but
this
essentially renders all of our data
and predictions
useless.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Just like that, all the work we've done to
prepare
for the spring Tenno Sho goes
down the drain.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Well... I guess it's time to make
adjustments to
the winning equation
again.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. What's wrong? It was always our
plan to
prove the equation by applying
it practically.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Let's make the most of what little time
we have
and do the best we can.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: ...Just like we did at the Kikuka Sho.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
We'll have to start over from square one.
If we do
this, it's going to take up a lot
of your time too.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
The Бива Хаяхидэ who used to be so
lost and
indecisive is nowhere to be
found anymore.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Uh, Тренер? Why are you looking at me
like tha—
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Gasp!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
M-my head isn't any bigger than usual!
See? It's
completely normal sized!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
No matter what life throws at her now,
she's
utterly unflappable. She's truly
progressed so
much.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
